title: This man slept through a 40 degree heat wave in his Tesla
title_candidates: A Tesla ran AC all night in a 40°C heat wave and only used 12% battery
How a Tesla held 20°C inside for 8 hours while it was 40°C outside
The Tesla feature that turns your car into an 8-hour air-conditioned hotel room
A man slept through a 40°C heat wave inside a Tesla and barely used the battery
Tesla quietly built a mode that keeps you cool all night without touching a plug
caption:
A Tesla owner slept overnight in their Model X Plaid in Austria during a brutal 40°C heat wave. Camp Mode held the cabin at exactly 20°C for 8 hours straight, using just 12% of the battery.

Camp Mode keeps the AC, heating, lights, and music running while the car is parked and locked, no charging cable needed. Most Tesla owners have never turned it on. The Model X Plaid carries roughly 100 kWh of battery total, so 12% for a full night is about the same draw as a small household fan running all day.

8 hours. 40°C outside. 20°C inside. 12% used.
